name: queryintent-validated-only-executed
description: R2 Outcome 2 execution gating: for a workspace that holds at least one APPROVED MetricDefinition the server must execute only a server-validated QueryIntent. A proposal the validator refuses (here: the RETIRED version of a previously APPROVED definition) must produce the typed queryintent refusal and its clarification, must never consult the sealed-intent executor, and must never fall through to the legacy free-text planner / idempotency path. internal/question/intent_gate.go is the guard: validateStructuredIntent returns the typed refusal instead of signalling 'no structured path'. Weakening that return lets a refused intent fall through to free text, which the arming seam turns into a test failure.
baseline_meaning: On the unmutated tree the refusal is honoured: executor calls stay 0, no run is returned, and the free-text/idempotency seam is never reached.
mutant_meaning: With the refusal return weakened to (zero, false, nil) the gate reports 'no structured path', Create proceeds to the free-text planner and the armed idempotency seam fails the test (RED). The mutant is therefore killed by the registered probe, not vacuous.
runner: tests/contracts/mutation-runner/main.go executes this case from tests/contracts/mutation-registry.json under the GO_UNIT harness for the invariant entry named above; the identical case is committed both here and in the registry so the proof is pinned to the product guard.
